item.title: The Next Phase of USMCA
item.description: In this week's column, Bill Reinsch argues that the USMCA review will prolong uncertainty, delaying investment and complicating North American trade negotiations.

item.title: Keeping Aluminum in Allied Hands: The Stakes of Alcoa’s South Africa Bet
item.description: Alcoa has made the largest U.S. mining supply chain investment in South Africa in years. Whether it marks the beginning of a new wave of Western investment will depend on South Africa’s policy choices—and its ability to compete for strategic mining capital.

item.title: States Weekly: July 8, 2026
item.description: This edition of States Weekly covers July 8, 2026.

item.title: Russian Attitudes Are Shifting as the War’s Effects Come Home
item.description: Ukraine's long-range strikes on Russian refineries combine military and economic pressure in ways previous shocks did not. While unlikely to transform public opinion, they raise the Kremlin's domestic costs and create an opportunity for the West to amplify the pressure.

item.title: China’s SLBM Test Underscores the Importance of a Ballistic Missile Launch Notification Agreement
item.description: On July 6, 2026, China conducted a submarine-launched ballistic missile test into the Pacific, its first ever into international waters. The insufficient notification underscores the importance of the Hague Code of Conduct.

item.title: How the Iran War Weighs on the U.S.-Saudi Partnership and Prospects for Normalization with Israel
item.description: Saudi Arabia neither sought nor engaged in the Iran war, yet it was forced to manage its consequences. The conflict has reinforced Riyadh’s determination to reduce regional instability while avoiding entanglement in crises beyond its control.

item.title: Make the Ankara Summit About European Defense Autonomy
item.description: As NATO meets in Ankara amid transatlantic strain, European allies must present the Trump administration with a burden-shifting roadmap, put its defense industry on a wartime footing, and advance NATO-EU cooperation by addressing Turkey’s role in European defense.
